Hey guys, in case anyone looks at this in the furture, here was my solution. run this with crontab every x minutes to monitor the /etc/passwd file for new accounts made on the system.


cp /etc/passwd ~/old_log

date >> ~/log
diff ~/old_log /etc/passwd >> ~/log
cp /etc/passwd ~/old_log
